# WhiteThroated

> WhiteThroated is an experimental pre-alpha web framework written in Swift and built on SwiftNIO. Its performance goal is not yet achieved; published results include limitations and provenance.

## Site pages

- [Home](https://whitethroated.com/): Framework goals, architecture, and current status.
- [Results](https://whitethroated.com/results): Benchmark matrices, verdicts, and per-cell provenance.
- [Methodology](https://whitethroated.com/methodology): Benchmark procedures, comparisons, and limitations.
- [Report archive](https://whitethroated.com/reports): Published reports, errata, and raw-data links.
- [Analytics](https://whitethroated.com/analytics): Page reads classified by requested URL.

## Source material

- [Tier 1 default-transport validation report](https://whitethroated.com/reports/tier1-default-2026-10-18): Rendered report, including its socket-option erratum.
- [Verbatim report](https://whitethroated.com/reports/benchmark-tier1-default-2026-10-18.md): Original report in Markdown.
- [Raw measurement data](https://whitethroated.com/data/tier1-default-2026-10-18.json): Per-round measurement data.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/whitethroated): Project repositories.

Use the reports and raw data for exact benchmark claims. The site distinguishes measurements from goals and documents known limitations.
